text:
Asha (PM): Quick sync: we have inconsistent phrasing between the console and docs for the help sidecar. Console shows 'Docs sidecar' in the header, docs use 'In-app docs'. Users got confused during the trial. We should pick one canonical term and ensure the sidecar links correctly. Diego (Design): Noted. I prefer 'In-app docs' as the canonical phrase. It's friendlier than 'sidecar' which is internal jargon. Pri (Docs): Docs agree: 'In-app docs' is the canonical term in the glossary. If UI uses a shorter header, include the canonical term in the first paragraph with a link to the glossary anchor. Lina (DevEx): Implementation notes: we support SPA internal links but need `data-internal-link` attribute so the router handles hash anchors. Also we have to update the i18n key `sidecar_title` to avoid translation drift if we change wording. Asha (PM): Proposal: visual header stays short as 'Help', first sentence inside the panel: 'In-app docs: contextual docs and deep links' with explicit links to `/docs/glossary#in-app-docs` and `/docs/guides/in-app-docs#usage`. Agree? Diego (Design): Works for layout. On narrow widths, make the first sentence the only visible line; collapse the crosslinks under a "Resources" disclosure. Pri (Docs): I'll add the glossary anchor `in-app-docs` and the guide anchor `in-app-docs`. Also will add copy: "In-app docs: contextual documentation surfaced from the console. Previously labeled 'Docs sidecar' in the UI." link-bot: docs deploy preview at https://deploy-preview/1012 (glossary anchor added) Lina (DevEx): For anchors we should canonicalize link paths: `/docs/glossary#in-app-docs` and `/docs/guides/in-app-docs#usage`. I'll make the sidecar open internal links with target=_self so they don't spawn new tabs. Asha (PM): Accessibility note: the short header must expose the canonical term to screen readers. Diego, can you add `aria-label="In-app docs"` to the header element when the visual label is 'Help'? Diego (Design): Yep. We'll also ensure the disclosure for Resources uses `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. Pri (Docs): Copy draft for the body: "In-app docs: contextual documentation surfaced from the console. Use these links to jump to the glossary and the usage guide for implementation notes." Explicit link text: 'Glossary: In-app docs' and 'Guide: Using in-app docs'. Lina (DevEx): Implementation snippet for engineers: ```html
Help

In-app docs: contextual documentation surfaced from the console. Glossary: In-app docs • Guide: Using in-app docs

...links...
``` Asha (PM): DevEx follow-ups: update i18n key, support data-internal-link handler, ensure anchors scroll in SPA, and add test plan for screen reader announcing the aria-label. ETA next sprint. Pri (Docs): Docs follow-ups: update glossary + guide anchors and add a short migration note for UI reviewers. ETA 48h. Diego (Design): I'll update the mock and run a 320px layout check; ensuring header doesn't overlap controls. ETA 72h. Lina (DevEx): Also will add a small compatibility redirect so old `/help` routes map to `/docs/guides/in-app-docs#overview`. Asha (PM): Decision summary: visual header 'Help' with aria-label 'In-app docs', first paragraph uses canonical term and explicit crosslinks, resources collapsed on mobile, SPA anchor handling and i18n key updated. Owners: Pri (docs), Diego (design), Lina (devex). We'll validate in staging. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
